job: Villa Bosnia - Nudura model house, Bosnia and Herzegovina

stages.title: Ground floor walls and openings
stages.desc: Ground-floor walls on the slab: Nudura 8in Standard external walls and the monolithic internal load-bearing walls. The garage steps down to -0.700 with its walls to +2.400; the rear box rises to +4.015 and the kitchen walls run +0.750 to +3.950. All the windows, doors and the garage door are shown.

stages.title: Second floor walls and parapet
stages.desc: Second-floor walls from +3.100: the external walls rise to the +6.695 parapet top, and the internal load-bearing walls run +3.300 to +5.586 under the roof slab. Windows and doors are shown.
